name: nemotron-czech-0.6b-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (config.json max_position_embeddings 5000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.6 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-09-29. CAVEAT: card states the export was selected after comparing historical test results, so this is not a blind test; the 0.099pp edge over the previous Czech checkpoint is not statistically established, though the 7.04pp gap to the NVIDIA base is (paired speaker-bootstrap CI [-9.25, -5.61]).
